messages:
Alex: Lantern Finance approaching us to move from CompetitorX. They want a 2-week POC: parity, cost delta, security checklist. Can we outline a plan?
Morgan: Parity scope: request/response schema, default params (temp/top_p), streaming format, embedding checksum, error codes, rate limits.
Sam: Pricing ask: they bill per-request; worried about token variability. We'll estimate for ~100k tokens/day peak for POC and present per-request vs per-token scenarios.
Meera: Security: KMS/HSM, VPC options, logs retention, SOC2 evidence. Recommend Dedicated in-region with customer-managed KMS for the POC.
Chris: Recommend a tiny compat shim and header mapping to minimize client changes. Example curl for shim provided in repo later. Note: tokenization differences ~5-12% possible.
Morgan: I'll produce a 50-prompt parity suite (short, long, multi-turn, injection, system-role). We'll measure semantic similarity + token delta.
Sam: I'll draft pricing appendix and one-pager for Lantern execs. Offer hosted discount or Dedicated trial credits for 2-week run.
Meera: I'll open a legal ticket for indemnity + pen-test windows and attach standard security Q&A.
security-bot: Uploaded security Q&A: https://redwood.internal/sec/qna-lantern-v1.pdf :thumbsup:
Chris: Streaming mismatch note: they expect newline-delimited JSON chunks. We'll prepare a small adaptor to repackage our framed events into ndjson.
Alex: Action items: Morgan -> parity suite + harness (Thu). Chris -> shim + stream adaptor sample (Wed). Sam -> pricing + one-pager (Mon). Meera -> security questionnaire + legal ticket (Wed). Post updates here.
Sam: Scheduling kickoff with Lantern infra/security for Monday AM. I'll confirm meeting and attach agenda.
Alex: Perfect. Keep updates brief in thread.
